job_title: Analista de Governança em Identidades e Acessos Sênior (IGA)
summary: Govern identity and access lifecycles, access certifications, RBAC/SoD matrices and privileged/non-human identities; support audits, security controls and workflow automation.
requirements: IAM/IGA/PAM, SSO and MFA; RBAC/SoD implementation; identity onboarding/moves/offboarding and access reviews; clear policy/procedure documentation; familiarity with PCI-DSS, ISO 27001/27002 and BCB 85/2021; IGA/IAM and password-vault tools; basic cloud architecture. SOX, n8n, Senhasegura/Keeper, regulated-finance experience and security certifications are preferred.
conditions: CLT; eight hours per day, Monday to Friday. The employer explicitly permits remote/home-office work for applicants outside Joinville. Original publication verified from the employer publishedAt field: 2026-11-13. Registration deadline: 2027-01-04.
